text_block_list.text: While walking around the academy—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
One-two-three-four!
Stay aware of your line all the way to your fingertips!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Ikuno-san.
Shall we wrap up concert practice here?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
...No, let's keep going...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ! ...Trainer...
choice_data_list: Pushing yourself any further would be...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "You can't just overlook it, you say? Then... would you mind watching just one song?"

Ikuno Dictus dances along with the music.
At first, I was worried about her stamina, but...

"A magnificent dance that betrayed none of it.
And... that earnest expression—"
Before I knew it, I was completely captivated.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... How... was that?
choice_data_list: To be honest... I felt like I wanted to see more.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yes, because I poured all my feelings into it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...In races, there are times when one chooses
not to expend every ounce of their strength."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Barring a few exceptions, there's almost always a "next time" for most races.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: However... the Winning Live is different.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
An opportunity to show myself from that day,
having achieved a glorious record,
to the benefactor who is right there.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"That opportunity" exists only on "that day."
There will be no next time.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I tried to stop her at first, too.
But she said... 'I want to repay my gratitude on stage.'

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
As a locodol...
There's no way I can just sit back and not help out!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-san will handle the stage choreography.
I will thoroughly take care of managing your fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Which is why... Trainer.
choice_data_list: You need classroom study for live shows too, right?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Which is why... Trainer.
choice_data_list: You need classroom study for live shows too, right?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
choice_data_list: I want to repay the favor too, you know.
I want to repay the favor too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪
Alright you two, I'm not going to go easy on you!
Even after that, under Hokko Tarumae's guidance, we engaged in thorough dance training.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"That's true...
There's knowledge required for the stage beyond just singing and dancing."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Like fan service, maybe!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's a super cute wink!
Next up, the heart pose!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...A heart... and, hup!
And so, I practiced fan service directly under Hokko Tarumae's guidance.
